source_snapshot.procedure: Confirm SUT configuration, clear logs, observe that the fault LED illuminates when the SUT has an error/warning event, then collect results/photos and unexpected logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: The fault LED responds to the system fault status
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: A person must observe and photograph the physical DUT node LED; DeepSeek also introduced a Green/Amber/Off lookup not present in the source.

original_test_intent.purpose: Visually verify that the physical fault LED for the identified DUT node changes to the platform-specified state when that same node is in an approved error or warning condition, and returns to the required state after recovery.
original_test_intent.target: One positively identified DUT node, its mapped physical fault LED and one owner-approved existing or controlled error/warning condition; not a different node, generic chassis LED or remote status field.
original_test_intent.scope: Direct manual LED observation correlated with a defined node fault state and supporting host/BMC evidence. The source does not require inventing a new fault injector if a controlled existing fault state can provide the approved condition.
original_test_intent.operation: Map the node and LED, preserve the normal baseline, have the owner/operator establish or select the approved bounded fault/warning state, synchronize event/log and direct LED photo/video evidence, recover through the documented method, confirm LED restoration and verify that the node and service are healthy.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One approved event-to-LED-response-to-recovery observation; the source lists five attended and five machine minutes but gives no response timeout or repeat count.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The mapped physical LED enters the exact specified color/solid/blink state within the approved timeout for the selected event, evidence from the same node correlates to that event, and the LED/node/service return to the defined recovered state without unrelated faults.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: DUT/node/LED physical map, selected event identity/severity/source, approved establishment method, expected LED table and timeout, synchronized before/event/recovery photo/video, operator record, host/BMC/SEL evidence, node/service health and recovery/restoration result.
ambiguities: The source omits node identity, LED location, fault-to-LED table, event severity/source, response timeout and recovery.
DeepSeek's Green/Amber/Off states are not source facts and cannot be accepted without a platform specification.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly rejects the invented color table and unsafe generic fault injection, and requires mapping, recovery, operator evidence and preserved logs. It treats missing provisionable event/LED inputs as permanent BLOCKED and frames execution as creating a fault, while later user feedback establishes MANUAL ONLY and permits an approved existing fault state.

applicable_history.decision: The earlier gate re-review retained BLOCKED because the node map, event, response table, operator and recovery were absent.

The later user-feedback re-review explicitly reclassified this case to MANUAL ONLY, recorded no irreducible blocked condition and allowed an approved error/warning event or controlled existing fault state.
Later user-confirmed boundaries outrank earlier missing-input over-BLOCKED logic.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: The physical visual purpose is clear, so V3 applies the later MANUAL ONLY decision. The missing event/map/table/timeout/recovery are readiness inputs. No unspecified fault injection is authorized; a controlled existing approved fault state is acceptable if it provides the required correlation.

available_now: The source requires a physical fault LED response to an error/warning condition and operator photo/log evidence.
Read-only node/topology/health and existing fault-state/log inventory can be collected without causing a fault.
missing_inputs: Exact DUT node identity and physical LED location/map for the platform revision
Owner-approved error/warning condition, whether existing or safely established, its severity/source/expected service impact and response timeout
Authoritative event-to-LED color/solid/blink table and recovered LED state
Qualified operator/camera, synchronized time/evidence plan, maintenance approval, abort thresholds, node/service recovery and OOB coverage
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The platform/LED owner supplies mapping and expected states; the RAS/service owner supplies the bounded event and recovery; the lab owner supplies operator/camera/maintenance approval and OOB coverage.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect node identity/topology, current physical-state report from the operator, BMC/host/SEL health and any controlled existing fault evidence without clearing logs
Prepare the node-event-LED correlation timeline and verify camera/time synchronization without inducing an event
prohibited_until_closed: Do not inject, remove, offline, reset, power-cycle or degrade a node with a guessed command merely to illuminate the LED
Do not invent a color table, use another node's LED, claim remote telemetry is direct visual proof, clear logs, continue after unexpected severity or improvise recovery
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The owner signs the node/LED/event mapping, expected response/timeout and recovered state; the selected event is bounded or already controlled; visual/log clocks align; maintenance, operator, OOB and tested recovery are active.

revision_candidate.purpose: Verify by direct observation that the mapped DUT-node fault LED displays the platform-defined state for one approved node error/warning condition and restores correctly after recovery.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact multi-node/server platform revision with an owner-approved node-to-LED map, fault-state table, bounded existing or controlled event, qualified observer and tested node/service recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One named DUT node, its mapped physical LED and the selected approved event only. Do not generalize another node/color table or expand into unspecified fault injection.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Node and LED map; selected event identity/severity/source; approved establishment or existing-state proof; expected LED color/state/blink and timeout; recovered state; operator/camera; synchronized clocks; maintenance/OOB; abort, recovery and service-health criteria.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve the normal node/LED/log baseline; have the qualified operator establish or confirm only the approved bounded condition; record the exact event and synchronized direct LED video/photo while the agent collects read-only same-node host/BMC/SEL evidence; recover using the documented procedure; confirm LED restoration and full node/service health.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Node/LED/event identities and expected table approved; event impact bounded or existing condition controlled; target workloads protected; response timeout/abort/recovery known; operator has direct safe view; clocks and evidence path ready; BMC/console/OOB available; logs preserved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Approved mapping/table/event/recovery; node identity; normal baseline; exact event timestamp/source/severity; direct mapped-LED photo/video showing state and timing; correlated host/BMC/SEL data; recovery actions; restored LED, node, management and service health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The exact platform revision's node/LED location map and owner-approved fault-indicator table, plus the selected event and recovery procedure.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never invent or broaden a fault, target the wrong node, remove/reset/power-cycle hardware without approval, accept logs as visual evidence, use an unverified color table, clear history or continue after unexpected service/OOB impact.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: The platform/RAS/service owners approve the node, event, maintenance impact, expected response and recovery. A qualified operator directly observes the physical LED; the end user decides the result.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Physical LED mapping, direct observation and any physical fault-state setup are manual. The agent may collect approved read-only corroborating evidence only and must not claim first-hand visual verification.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on unexpected severity, wrong-node response, service loss, management degradation or unclassified LED state; preserve the event/visual/log timeline, execute only the tested node recovery, confirm LED and service restoration, and quarantine unresolved degradation.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved node/LED/event map, absent expected state/timeout, unbounded or guessed fault, active unprotected workload, unavailable operator/OOB/recovery, wrong-node or unexpected LED response, monitoring/evidence loss, service/management impact beyond approval or failed recovery.

identified_defects: V2 confuses missing provisionable event/mapping inputs with an irreducible BLOCKED capability despite the later MANUAL ONLY user decision.
V2 emphasizes creating a fault; the later decision allows a controlled existing approved fault state and therefore avoids needless injection.
DeepSeek invents a Green/Amber/Off table absent from the source.
reason_for_change: Apply the later user-confirmed manual classification, keep missing event details as readiness gates and explicitly prefer a controlled existing condition where valid rather than creating an unspecified critical fault.

new_technical_evidence.title: Blocked feedback re-review 002
new_technical_evidence.supports: The later user-feedback review classifies the case MANUAL ONLY, records no actual irreducible blocker, and accepts an approved event or controlled existing fault state while forbidding unspecified injection.

removed_ambiguities: Separates the physical visual capability from current event/map readiness.
Makes same-node, same-event time correlation and recovered LED/service state mandatory.
resolved_blockers: The case is not permanently BLOCKED: owner-supplied mapping/event/table and manual observation make it executable without changing its physical acceptance boundary.
remaining_blockers: Current execution remains prohibited until the node/LED map, approved bounded or existing event, expected response/timeout, operator, maintenance and recovery are supplied.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 corrects over-BLOCKED classification using the later user decision, removes the assumption that a new fault must be injected, keeps every no-guess and recovery control, and requires synchronized same-node visual/log evidence plus verified restoration.

agent_understanding_result.notes: This critical-risk BLOCKED-to-MANUAL ONLY contract is queued for isolated validation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The source requires the DUT-node physical fault LED to respond when that SUT has an error/warning event.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 protects the critical event but marks provisionable inputs BLOCKED; later user feedback says MANUAL ONLY and permits a controlled existing condition.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: No guessed fault is permitted; use only an approved bounded or controlled existing event, direct mapped-LED evidence, same-node logs and tested recovery with OOB coverage.
